title: Permanent Pond Decision
goal: Choose and purchase the permanent pond vessel that best fits the rectangular Zen design, gives the lotus a stable long-term home, and leaves permanent pump and filtration selection to Phase 3.
preferredChoice: Algreen Manhattan 40-inch Balcony Planter & Pond from Wayfair
decisionSummary: The final comparison is between the Algreen Manhattan rectangular planter pond from Wayfair and the Blagdon/Pennington Aquagarden 50-gallon pond kit from Walmart. The Algreen Manhattan is the preferred choice, but Phase 2 remains open until it is purchased.
whyPreferred: The clean 40 x 20 x 18-inch rectangular shape fits the planned architectural Zen pond design better than the more traditional pond-kit appearance.
Wayfair explicitly lists the Manhattan as suitable for use as an above-ground water garden, with durable rotomolded outdoor construction.
The Manhattan vessel can be bought separately, allowing Phase 3 to select the pump, mechanical filtration and biological filtration intentionally instead of being locked into bundled equipment.
At the recorded price snapshot, the Wayfair Manhattan vessel cost less than the Walmart Aquagarden kit, leaving more room in the project budget for the filtration system we actually want.
The overall visual design is the deciding factor: the Manhattan looks more like an intentional rectangular garden feature and better supports the planned jasmine, lotus and Buddha composition.
